title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^122.35

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.438, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.35 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.329691. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
